scope: static reconciliation of ipsw KEXT inventory against kernelcache fileset headers; no load addresses in this file
rules: fileset_backed: identifier in fileset, load address equals the entry header, executable field present
codeless: not in fileset, no executable field, sentinel load address
pseudo_kext: not in fileset, identifier prefix com.apple.kpi., executable names a kernel component, sentinel address
alias: two fileset-backed records share one executable load address (none found)
duplicate: identifier listed more than once (none found)
other: anything else with a sentinel address; fileset entries with no inventory record
unresolved: evidence conflicts or does not fit a category
interpretation: Records outside the fileset are not treated as missing firmware components. Codeless and pseudo-KEXT records describe personality or interface bundles and are expected to have no fileset entry. The one fileset entry without an inventory record is the kernel image itself.

display_name_collisions: Image4 (two records; distinct identifiers and fileset entries)
I/O Kit Driver for USB HID Devices (two records; distinct identifiers)
